metadata.description:
Personal monitor mixer for REAPER. Each performer opens a phone/tablet/laptop page, picks their monitor track, and dials in their own mix of receives. Includes a Project Settings view for live tempo and time-signature changes.
Source: https://github.com/AriKuorikoski/monarimix

Performer-facing monitor mixer plus a Project Settings panel for tempo and time signature. Layout auto-flips between horizontal (portrait) and vertical (landscape) channel strips. Persists user preferences in localStorage.

version.author: Ari Kuorikoski
version.changelog: + Initial release. + Orientation-based layout switching (portrait = horizontal sliders, landscape = vertical channel strips). + Manual layout-mode override via URL hash and toggle button (Auto / Vertical / Horizontal). + Project Settings panel with tempo (via OSC) and time signature (via companion ReaScript). + Auto-discovery of the time-sig action ID via REAPER ExtState; manual paste available as fallback.

reapack.name: monarimix_set_timesig.lua
reapack.desc: MoreMe 2: apply time signature from project ExtState

metadata.description: Companion ReaScript for the monarimix.html web page. Reads numerator and denominator from project ExtState (section "MoreMe", keys "tsig_num" and "tsig_den"), applies them as the project's initial time signature, and self-registers its command ID into ExtState so the web page can auto-discover it. Run once from the Action List after install for self-registration.

version.author: Ari Kuorikoski
version.changelog: + Initial release. Sets project time signature non-interactively via SetTempoTimeSigMarker(). Self-registers its command ID for the web page.

reapack.name: monarimix_monitor.lua
reapack.desc: MoreMe 2: optional background monitor for live tempo readback

metadata.description: Optional companion script. Runs continuously in the background and writes the project's current tempo into ExtState so the monarimix.html page can display live tempo updates. Toggle on/off by running the action from the REAPER Action List. Add to __startup.lua to auto-launch at REAPER start.

version.author: Ari Kuorikoski
version.changelog: + Initial release. Defer-based loop with single-instance guard.
